title: CaptureViewport Command
description: Capture a viewport screenshot for visual analysis, with metadata. Any temporary display mode, camera or framing is restored after capture. An explicit camera (camera_location, camera_target, lens_length) and framing (frame_object_ids, frame_bbox, zoom_to_fit true) are refused together with invalid_argument.

viewport.description: Target viewport identifier: active, perspective, top, front, right, back, left, bottom, or custom name

show_grid.description: Whether to show the viewport grid

show_axes.description: Whether to show world axes indicator

show_cplane_axes.description: Whether to show construction plane axes

zoom_to_fit.description: Fit visible objects to the requested image dimensions; restore the original viewport camera and projection after capture. true cannot be combined with camera_location, camera_target or lens_length

display_mode.description: Display mode name for this capture only, for example Shaded, Wireframe, Rendered, Ghosted, Technical, Arctic. Default: the viewport's current mode

camera_location.description: Temporary camera location [x, y, z]. Cannot be combined with frame_object_ids, frame_bbox or zoom_to_fit

camera_target.description: Temporary camera target [x, y, z]. Cannot be combined with frame_object_ids, frame_bbox or zoom_to_fit

lens_length.description: Temporary 35mm-equivalent lens length in millimetres (perspective views). Part of the explicit camera: cannot be combined with frame_object_ids, frame_bbox or zoom_to_fit

frame_object_ids.description: Temporarily frame the capture on these objects. Cannot be combined with camera_location, camera_target or lens_length

frame_bbox.description: Temporarily frame the capture on this world-space box (a degenerate box is padded). Cannot be combined with camera_location, camera_target or lens_length
